changelog: - **Slack Huddle links are recognised as bring-your-own meeting links** (#2879, PR 1 of the Slack huddle trial). `meetingProviderName()` returns “Slack Huddle” for `https://app.slack.com/huddle/<TEAM>/<CHANNEL>`, so the meeting panel's fallback button reads “Open in Slack Huddle” and the link-box hint says where it opens; `EMBEDDABLE_MEETING_HOSTS` is unchanged (Slack cannot be framed) and `checkPastedMeetingLink()` is not relaxed — the link already passed it. New dependency-free `src/lib/slackHuddle.ts` (`buildHuddleUrl` / `parseHuddleUrl`, strict on the `T…` / `[CDG]…` id grammar) with a `@smoke` unit spec, an untagged e2e for the account page and the panel, and a “Slack Huddle link” section in `docs/video-calls-jaas.md`.

en: Teams that live in Slack can meet in a huddle: paste a channel's huddle link as your personal room or into a meeting, and the app recognises it — the meeting panel offers “Open in Slack Huddle” and the hint under the link box says where it opens. Only workspace members can join a huddle, so keep a built-in room for mentees and guests outside Slack.
tr: Slack'te yaşayan ekipler huddle'da görüşebilir: bir kanalın huddle bağlantısını kişisel odan olarak ya da bir görüşmeye yapıştır, uygulama bunu tanır — toplantı paneli “Slack Huddle ile aç” der ve bağlantı kutusunun altındaki ipucu nerede açılacağını söyler. Huddle'a yalnızca çalışma alanı üyeleri katılabilir; Slack dışındaki mentee ve konuklar için yerleşik odayı kullan.
de: Teams, die in Slack arbeiten, können sich im Huddle treffen: Füge den Huddle-Link eines Kanals als persönlichen Raum oder in eine Besprechung ein, und die App erkennt ihn — das Panel bietet „In Slack Huddle öffnen“ an, und der Hinweis unter dem Linkfeld sagt, wo er sich öffnet. Einem Huddle können nur Workspace-Mitglieder beitreten; für Mentees und Gäste außerhalb von Slack bleibt der eingebaute Raum.
